features: COMPACT DESIGN: The G'FIVE A29 features a pocket-friendly body with a distinctive green camouflage finish, ideal for daily carry.
COLOUR LCD DISPLAY: Equipped with a 0.66-inch colour LCD screen paired with a physical numeric keypad for a traditional handset experience.
LONG-LASTING BATTERY: Powered by an 800mAh battery, this mini handset delivers reliable power despite its small and portable form factor.
BLUETOOTH DIALER: Pairs with a compatible smartphone via Bluetooth to enable making and receiving calls with contact synchronisation support.
ONBOARD MEMORY: Comes with 32MB + 32MB built-in memory; verify SIM and network compatibility before purchasing for standalone cellular use.
description: Carry a compact handset with the G'FIVE A29 Mini Keypad Mobile Phone. Its pocket-friendly design and green camouflage finish combine everyday portability with a distinctive look. The A29 features a 0.66-inch colour LCD display, a physical numeric keypad, an 800mAh battery and 32MB + 32MB memory. Its compact controls offer a traditional keypad experience in a small body. Bluetooth dialer functionality allows the handset to pair with a compatible smartphone for making and receiving calls. Calling features and contact synchronisation depend on smartphone compatibility and supported settings. Choose the G'FIVE A29 for a portable mini handset that is convenient to carry during commutes, travel and daily activities. Check SIM and mobile-network compatibility before purchasing for standalone cellular use.
